children: China real estate developer's half-year revenue was nearly flat yr/yr at RMB 51.1 mln
Net loss attributable widened to RMB 253.5 mln for the six months ended 30 June 2026
Company remains in liquidation and trading suspension continues
The Group plans to extend into elderly care, community healthcare and housekeeping as value-added service revenue is expected to exceed 40% in 2026
ABSENT IMPAIRMENT REVERSAL – Net loss widened to RMB253.5 mln, primarily due to the absence of a RMB101.7 mln one-off reversal of impairment losses on deconsolidated subsidiaries
FEWER MANAGED PROPERTIES – Revenue fell 1.2% to RMB51.1 mln as the number of properties under management declined to 15 from 16
VENDOR COST CONTROLS – Gross margin rose to 56.6% from 50.7% due to stricter cost controls, including improved vendor engagement processes
